items.description: reading a SKU's detail through the boundary for a sku seeded across more than one location (unique uuid-suffixed sku, cleaned up after) returns a JSON collection with one entry per location, each carrying that location and its quantity, read through service and repository against the branch DB

the group-by-location shaping (one row per location for a sku) lives in the service and the sku-filtered query is the repository's sole ORM touch; the boundary and React component contain no shaping or ORM logic (read-path layering contract)
the SKU-detail view renders one row per location showing that location and its quantity via its data-testid seams (client component)

reading a SKU's detail through the boundary for a record seeded with a known inventory_code (unique uuid-suffixed sku/location, cleaned up after) returns that combined inventory_code alongside the location and quantity in the entry's JSON, projected by the repository/service against the branch DB
the SKU-detail entry renders the combined inventory_code (tracking code) beside its location via its data-testid seam (client component)

reading a SKU's detail through the boundary for a sku seeded with no par_level (unique uuid-suffixed sku, cleaned up after) returns the service's explicit "not tracked" value for the par level in the JSON rather than a null or an error, against the branch DB
the par-level region renders the explicit "not tracked" state via its data-testid seam when the DTO reports par level not tracked, rather than a blank region or a null crash (client component)

reading a KNOWN sku that holds no stock rows (a unique uuid-suffixed sku with no rows seeded) through the boundary returns an empty JSON stock collection with a 200 success (not a 404), distinguishing known-empty from unknown, read through service and repository against the branch DB
the SKU-detail view maps a known-empty result to the explicit "No stock" state via its data-testid seam rather than a blank page (client component)

requesting a sku that is absent from the branch through the boundary returns a 404 not-found response, distinct from AC4's known-empty 200, read through the service's known-vs-unknown decision against the branch DB
the SKU-detail view renders a not-found state via its data-testid seam for an unknown sku rather than an empty-stock view or an error page (client component)
